risks.title: Footage loss
risks.stopCondition: Stop before any delete, overwrite, or in-place cleanup of original media when a second hash-verified copy is absent.
requiredEvidence: hash of the original bytes before the experiment
hash-verified second copy that restores without the original path
explicit statement that derived proxies are not a substitute for the original
risks.reversibleAlternative: Copy originals to a content-addressed holding area and compare hashes before any destructive storage experiment.

risks.title: Misleading labels
risks.stopCondition: Stop publication if a label asserts physical S23 qualification, calibrated colour, a sustained stream, or firmware access that the evidence does not show.
requiredEvidence: evidence class and source revision bound to the label
explicit non-claims for physical, calibrated, and firmware results
separation of advertised capability from a verified stream
risks.reversibleAlternative: Mark the result advertised-only, exploratory, or inconclusive and keep the narrower software finding.

risks.title: Thermal load
risks.stopCondition: Stop a capture or stress experiment when a predeclared temperature, throttle, or battery limit is crossed, or when no temperature observation with unit and domain is available.
requiredEvidence: temperature samples with unit and domain
duration and abort threshold declared before the run
device-variant identity when a physical observation is claimed
risks.reversibleAlternative: Use short host or emulator timing runs and existing thermal notes before any long physical take.

risks.title: Rendering instability
risks.stopCondition: Stop promotion of a renderer when a crash, unreproducible frame, or unretained source change appears in the acceptance set.
requiredEvidence: frame-by-frame comparison against the retained reference
crash or failure log kept beside any passing summary
risks.reversibleAlternative: Compare a CPU reference against retained source frames before changing a GPU path.

risks.title: Licensing
risks.stopCondition: Stop public bundling or redistribution when owner, licence, or permitted use is unknown.
requiredEvidence: permitted use, including whether redistribution is allowed
risks.reversibleAlternative: Keep uncleared media in private comparison and out of the public bundle.

risks.title: Firmware modification
risks.stopCondition: Stop before any flash, bootloader change, or protection change unless a blocked stream is identified and a device-specific recovery procedure is verified. User enthusiasm is not authorization.
requiredEvidence: identified blocked stream that application-level paths cannot produce
fresh explicit authorization distinct from user enthusiasm
risks.reversibleAlternative: Run non-destructive Camera2 and application-level capability discovery on host fixtures, emulator reports, or read-only device records.
